reviews.text:
always professional, always welcoming,,, always supportive and always caring people. Thank you for taking care of JAXX.
very much appreciative.
Dr. T is the best.  We drive an extra 10 miles to see him. Staff ius also A-1
Great caring for all my pets any the friendly staff
After my first visit, I feel good about this Vet🙏
Dr. Thordarson and his staff are the best.  You could not ask for any better for your pets.
We really liked Dr. Marco for years as the veterinarian here but he recently retired and Dr. Blake our new vet is the best.
The clinic is very clean and the staff is super friendly. The doctor was amazing with my cat and handled everything with great care. I will definitely come back!
Best team ever!

I'm a first time dog mom and was nervous about my bringing my son to a new vet but this place was amazing!! Their staff was extremely helpful and welcoming, & answered all of my questions. I will definitley be coming back and referring them!

I’ve had such a great experience at Northridge Animal Hospital. Dr. Blake and the entire staff are wonderful—very kind, caring, and professional. You can really tell they take their time with each pet and are very thorough with their exams.

I’ve been there twice so far, and both times everything was handled quickly and efficiently without ever feeling rushed. Dr. Blake takes the time to answer every question, explain everything clearly, and make sure you understand the recommendations and policies.

It’s such a good feeling to find a veterinary office where you feel like your pet is genuinely cared for. I’m very happy with my experience and would definitely recommend Dr. Blake and the team!

Disgraceful front office staff behavior. Made me sit with my dog and four kids for 20 minutes past our appointment time because their lunch was running late. I was never offered an apology, I was told I was called twice (not true) and when I complained I was sent a client termination letter. Find a professional who behaves like one and who values your time, money and animal more than their lunch hour.
All of the doctors and employees are very friendly, helpful, kind, and caring.  They look happy to see our pets, and I know that our furry ones are in good hands.

I love this place.  All the staff and Dr. Blake and Dr. Schmidt are great and have so much patience with us and all of our questions. I would not go anywhere else.  Very happy we found them for all of our pups.

The staff here really cares. We have come here multiple times and had to put our pets to sleep and although it’s really tough I couldn’t imagine anyone being anymore empathetic than these guys, all of them make you and your family extremely comfortable. On top of all that they changed us a small amount of money compared to other vets. Thanks for taking care of us in all aspects I appreciate it!

Always have a great experience when we bring our pets to Northridge Animal Medical Center. The staff are kind and friendly and Dr Blake is great with our pups.
Prices are very reasonable too.

Dr. Blake is kind, compassionate, and takes the time to explain all of the options when there is a problem. I always feel at ease knowing my fur babies, Lucy and Watson are in his good hands. His prices are fair—still expensive, as veterinary care can be, but more reasonable than many other veterinarians in the Los Angeles area. I highly recommend Dr. Blake!  Front office staff and techs are wonderful as well!! ☺️
Staff friendly and efficient. Dr. Blake was thorough in his expiations and communication!
I came for my kitty’s shots and nails and they were great with him even though he was very nervous!! Nice people, fair price, I’m so happy I decided to come.
Awesome. Staff including Dr Blake are terrific
It was such a nice visit with Dr Erin. She was very helpful, polite and answered all our questions with patience. She handled our little kitten with such grace too. Definitely coming back again!
All the employees at your hospital are very kind, friendly, and animal people! Kamalo and I both feel very taken care of when we visit you. Thank you so much! 😻🙏
I deeply appreciate everyone's concerns, kindness, and compassion for Flor and Tiger. You are the best.
Dr. Haworth is the best and the office staff are always very friendly.
Most knowledgable and empathetic vet I have ever met. It is a pleasure to have him treat our animals.
Clean and all employee are nice and helpful. Would highly recommend.
Best care yet
Wonderful staff, caring, kind, knowledgeable and always great with my dog:)
Great buvett very professional compassionate at a great price
Excellent service! The doctor is very knowledgeable and the staff members are very nice and welcoming. My dogs enjoyed their visit.
We absolutely loved Dr. Haworth, and more importantly, our doggo loved her! He is already feeling better after the first chiropractic adjustment she gave him. We will be back!

I’ve been coming to this hospital for over a decade and have taken all of my pets there. Everyone who works there truly cares about the animals and treats them with so much compassion. I miss Dr. Marco, but I really love Dr. Erinn. You can absolutely trust that your pet will receive excellent care here.
Dr. Blake and staff are amazing! They are thoughtful and caring. My pets are in great hands. I am fortunate to have them nearby.
Took my dog

I love this place amd have recommended  it to my friends.   The staff is excellent with great animal and people skills.   Clean throughout.   Dr Blake is great with my dog.   Gentle and caring.    And  I love  being able to book appointments on line.
Dr. Blake is not only smart, but also incredibly caring and compassionate. The front desk staff  are so caring and welcoming. Highly recommend this place for top-notch care for your fur babies.
I’ve been coming here for over 5 years and trust them completely. The team is caring, professional, and always takes great care of my dogs.
Excellent experience and great Doctor that took care of Jasper.  Highly encourage anyone to take their pet to Northridge Vet  for a friendly and happy experience.   Thank you.
Thanks for seeing Henry on immediate notice and getting him back in shape for a quick recovery after his successful surgery🙏 …
We loved Sargent so much and are so grateful we can continue to care for and watch the rest of your pets grow.
just called for a quote for extraction of one tooth alone and it starts at $1k (not including exam and blood work).

Recently had to put my baby to sleep, I was quoted $1200+ at the Mission Veterinary Clinic and Animal Emergency Hospital so I came here and the price difference was immensely different. So affordable and came with a very nice wooden box and keepsakes  within the package. Even came with a card written and signed by all the staff. It was unexpected and very appreciated. Everyone is very sweet and I recommend people come here MUCH more than any other vet in the area. Top quality service.

I take my 14 year old shepard mix here for chiropractic treatment. Dr. Hayworth is warm, sincere and very welcoming.  She really cares how her clients are doing and compares corrections each visit.  My pups doing pretty great for a 14 year old, and we’ll be continuing our visits to help ensure Patches’ longevity and quality of life.  Thank you Dr. Hayworth!

We have consistently had a great experience here. The team is professional, kind and clearly cares about our fur-babies. We are always seen in a timely manner and everything is explained with clarity and compassion. It is reassuring to know our family is in such great hands. Dr. Blake is by far the best vet we have been to!
The staff are wonderful as well as Dr Blake T.

I had an excellent experience with this veterinary clinic. I was able to get an appointment the very next day after I called. When I arrived on time, I was seen right away despite other clients being there. The assistant was incredibly kind and helped calm my dog, who was scared and in pain. The doctor came in quickly, examined him efficiently, and provided a written proposal with clear costs for each suggested treatment and test. I appreciated being able to choose the most urgent treatments without any pressure. We left with my dog feeling much better—no longer hurt or frightened. It was truly comforting to find such a competent, transparent, and caring veterinary team in my area. Highly recommended!
Eileen is the best!

I HIGHLY recommend this office! The staff and Dr Blake are so nice and helpful. I feel like my fur babies are treated really well and my questions/concerns are always addressed thoroughly. I don’t feel like I’m being overcharged for services which is a huge plus. I feel very comfortable with this vet office. It’s always really clean and low stress when visiting.
The staff and doctors are truly wonderful! I have been bringing my beloved pets here for several years, and they have consistently provided excellent care. I highly recommend their services!

I adore Dr. Blake and the whole team! He is insightful, honest, and deeply caring with all my kitties. I sense that he us deeply intelligent and looks for the route causes not the easy answers. I trust he will research the best care options and stays up to date on holistic as well as veterinary medicine. Too many times I have had vets prescribe a diet high in corn or soy for an allergy, run unnecessary tests, and not be frank about realistic options or treatments. I literally moved 45-1 hour away and I still make the trip, because he and the rest of the team are worth their weight in gold! I won't go anywhere else with my babies!
Everyone there is so nice and helpful, we sleep well knowing that our babies will be well taken care of.
Dr. Blake is very knowledgeable and helpful.
Compassionate, quality care when you most need it.
Very professional and super nice. I would recommend this place.
Great experience. Brought my dog for an emergency visit and they quickly handled the situation. My pup and I are grateful. A before and after a bee sting

Our vet Dr. Thordarson is so knowledgeable and really explains issues in a detailed explanation. I highly recommend Northridge Animal Medical Center to all my pet parents. The front desk staff is so accommodating and professional. I trust Doctor Blake with my Cat and Dog and know they are being seen by a true professional!!!!
Amazing vet office. Wonderful kind staff and vet doctors.
I like Dr Blake. He takes the time to listen to my concerns and gives multiple options to remedy the problem. The staff is friendly and helpful.
Dr Blake and his amazing staff are always so welcoming and amazing with my Dottie!  I recommend them to everyone!

I just love the staff there. Everyone was so compassionate and caring about our grief of saying goodbye to our beloved kitty Junior. Doctor Blake was the most caring Vet Doctor that I have seen at over 5 different Vet facilities. I totally recommend this animal hospital to everyone..❤️

The staff is the most caring I have ever seen. Dr. Blake is the most compassionate Dr.  he took time to explain everything to me.  Thanks to the staff too.  They smile and
Take time with you❤️❤️

My cat Gata was very sick so I took her to see Dr. Blake. He was very kind and took the time to answer my questions and give me all the options based on his recommendation. I didn't feel like I was just another client. We were like family and he kept me updated with her condition. She ended up needing surgery and Dr. Blake was very understanding and listened to all my concerns.
The entire staff was friendly and helpful. Their compassion for my cat and what I was going through was extremely appreciated. Thank you for the excellent care you gave to Gata and to myself!
I highly recommend taking your beloved pets to Northridge Animal Medical Center.
I’ve had nothing but great experiences with Northridge Animal Medical Center. Highly recommend, Happy dog, Happy life…
Thank you for taking the time to rate us 5 STARS :]

Thank you so much for helping my cat Opal.. Doctor is the best. Everyone there made Opal and I feel very comfortable. Reasonably priced, friendly staff, overall experience was great.. I would definitely recommend them to someone looking for a good veterinary practice.

Listen. This Vet is Tired and Greedy and will nickel and dime you once you are there and doesn't care if you come back or not. Very Cavalier and cocky staff. There is no good energy when you walk in, all they see is dollar signs. Please believe me.  They really take every opportunity to take advantage of you in the most selfish, non-caring (although they act like they do but they don't). All they see is money money money walking through their door/s with their greedy eyes. GO to the San Fernando Vet Hospital on Truman Street. It's a funky wonderful place and the professional caring vet visit is only 35 dollars. I promise they are the best!
Fantastic service, great people, they really care :)
Northridge Animal Medical Center does a great job communicating and providing veterinarian services to our Female, Ragdoll cat. Thank you guys!

Very sincere as caring for my 3 lovely dogs. Very knowledgeable and teaches good information.  I always feel my pets and I are lucky to find such good caring doctors and staff.            Excellent! Care
Amazing staff here! So thankful my babies have vets and nurses that care for them so much!

Thank you all so much for always taking care of our Dolly. She loves your staff, and we appreciate you all so much for all the love and care you've given her all these years.
Most dogs don't like to go to the vet, but whenever I say, "Let's go see Vanessa," she knows exactly where we're going, and she gets so happy to see  her and everyone else there too. We love you guys!

We take all 3 of our dogs to Northridge Animal Medical Center. The reception staff are friendly, super helpful and kind. The vets are also wonderful and always take great care of our dogs. Highly recommend. Price is always fair.

Everyone at the Northridge Animal Medical Center is professional and very friendly. They care about each pet as if they were their own. I highly recommend them to anyone with pets!
Dr. Blake is very caring and takes time to answer any questions thoroughly. The staff is wonderful, so helpful! I’ve been taking my pets to Northridge Animal Clinic for the past 25 years, and I will never switch. They are the best!
My 3 "girls" (Beagles) love the vets and staff at Northridge AMC! Everyone is very friendly and professional. I recommend them to all my friends. Thanks Dr. Marco and Dr. Blake!
Turned away at the door. Stellar service, guys.
Great vet and attending staff. Punctual, easy to book using the app, very pleasant and personable. Highly recomment.
Love this place always helpful
